description: Li coefficients lambda_n = 2*Re[sum_{k=1}^{K} (1-(1-1/rho_k)^n)], K=500 zero pairs. Li criterion: RH <=> lambda_n >= 0 for all n. Comparison: second-window Schur eig_full(N) is a different convergent.
note: lambda_n values are all positive (consistent with RH), growing as O(n log n). The Schur eig_full(N) is a separate convergent: it measures min-eigenvalue of the truncated Schur matrix, not the Li sum. Both are truncated approximations that improve with more terms (N or K).
